metadata.inclusion: Press the function button 3 times within 1.5 seconds. The smoke detector will emit a 2-tone beep and the LED will flash once.
metadata.exclusion: Press the function button 3 times within 1.5 seconds. The smoke detector will emit a 2-tone beep and the LED will flash once.
metadata.reset: Press and hold the function button for 20 seconds. The smoke detector beeps after 7 seconds to indicate that the reset has started, and beeps again after 20 seconds to confirm the reset.
